card.line: Tahpanhes was a city in Egypt where Jewish refugees fled after Jerusalem fell, and where God gave Jeremiah a message about Babylon's coming attack.

moments.title: Refugees reach Egypt
moments.text: The people did not obey the LORD, but went into Egypt anyway. Jeremiah and Baruch went with them, and they came as far as Tahpanhes.

moments.title: Stones at Pharaoh's palace
moments.text: The LORD told Jeremiah to bury large stones in the clay pavement at the entrance to Pharaoh's palace while the Jews watched. God said Nebuchadnezzar would set his throne over those stones and strike Egypt.

moments.title: Warning to the Jews in Egypt
moments.text: God spoke to all the Jews living in Egypt, including those in Tahpanhes. He reminded them that Jerusalem lay in ruins because of idol worship, and asked why they were harming themselves.

moments.title: A call to get ready for war
moments.text: The LORD told Jeremiah to announce in Tahpanhes and other Egyptian cities that the sword was coming. Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon was about to strike Egypt.
